evidence_slice: City of York Council adopted the City of York Local Plan on 27 February 2025. Adopted Policy SS9 identifies ST7, Land East of Metcalfe Lane, as a garden village strategic development site expected to deliver approximately 845 dwellings. City of York Council's public 2025 LocalPlanPoliciesMap exposes layer 14, Strategic Housing Sites, as an esriGeometryPolygon feature layer and supports JSON, GeoJSON and PBF query formats.
binding_method: adopted strategic housing site policy plus authority-hosted 2025 policies-map MapServer polygon layer; canonical parcel binding delegated to local OpenCode
